limitations: Setup calls were issued from the orchestrating session over the daemon's own MCP HTTP endpoint (POST http://127.0.0.1:6502/, initialize + tools/call) because the Roslynk MCP tools were not registered in the orchestrating session (the server was re-registered for the measured session only). Timestamps are that session's message timestamps.

Setup duration is open_solution to the first Ready observation, both at second resolution: open_solution issued 2026-10-27T16:20:02Z, first Ready 2026-10-27T16:20:08Z, so 6.0 s with up to ±1 s granularity.
Token usage for the setup calls is unavailable: the harness records token usage per session, and the orchestrating session's aggregate covers setup and all orchestration.

The daemon (pid 32736) was already running from the same checkout before setup and was not restarted between setup and the measured session; the solution was opened ~28 s before the measured session started.
